precondition_sources.text: The packedFloat input passed to Ln::ln is a negative number.

intent_sources.text: Ln::ln must check whether the passed packedFloat input is negative at the start of the function and revert if it is negative.
The natural log of a negative number is undefined and must not be returned as a defined value.
